title: Climate Action Toolkit for World Heritage tested in the Colonial City of Santo Domingo
content:
The Colonial City of Santo Domingo in the Dominican Republic is hosting the first pilot application of the Climate Action Toolkit at a cultural site, and the first in Latin America and the Caribbean. The pilot, taking place from September to November 2026, combines online sessions with an in-person workshop held from 5 to 9 October.

title: The Asia-Pacific Dialogue on Heritage and Authenticity brings new perspectives to World Heritage preservation
content: From 27 September to 1 October 2026, a Dialogue on Heritage and Authenticity for the Asia-Pacific region took place in Ha Noi and Ninh Binh (Viet Nam). title: COP17: New assessment highlights World Heritage Convention's contribution to global biodiversity goals
content:
A new technical note published by the IUCN World Commission on Protected Areas (WCPA), in partnership with the UNESCO World Heritage Centre, examines how the World Heritage Convention is reflected in national efforts to implement the Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (GBF). It also identifies opportunities to further strengthen its contribution to global biodiversity goals.

title: UNESCO hosted regional capacity-building workshop for natural World Heritage in Central Asia and Mongolia in Almaty
content:
UNESCO and IUCN brought together State Party representatives and site managers from the heart of Eurasia, with support of the UNESCO/Republic of Korea Funds-in-Trust project aiming to enhance transnational cooperation.
